title: Halve the internal/reconcile test suite
description: t8u's final review: internal/reconcile's full suite is ~13% faster after 0bg (337→293 serial min; CI reconcile shards 300/271/258s → 287/247/183s), short of t8u's original goal of halving it. The operator accepted that and re-scoped t8u (2026-10-08, "merge them all"); halving moves here. It needs kf1 (the reconciler's own origin reads, now the suite's biggest measured git cost) and 9xx (the tracker mirror's per-write path), with a before/after recorded on a quiet host, measured the same way as t8u's baseline.
acceptance_criteria:
[A1] internal/reconcile's full suite takes at most half of t8u's recorded baseline on the same host, with the before/after recorded.
[A2] make gate passes and CI is green.
